items.title: Red Holloway interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: I had a chance to meet John Coltrane when he was with Dizzy. And I had met him before that, in fact I met him with Eddie “Cleanhead” Vinson.

ctx.x: That gives the music a certain sense of authenticity.

Yeah, yeah. So like I feel very privileged to have lived during this particular era. Because a lot of the young musicians, they do no, well not all of them, but a lot of them don’t do any research. Now I’ll tell you, I had a chance to meet John Coltrane when he was with Dizzy. And I had met him before that, in fact I met him with Eddie “Cleanhead” Vinson. But he of course, he wasn’t playing the way he was when he [inaudible]. But he could play the blues. I’m talking about play some real blues. And on one of his…
